reason: Provides gate access information and key location for the private road leading to the TRN-042 and BTS-233 sites.

knowledge.summary: Access to the TRN-042 and BTS-233 sites via the private road requires a key located in a lockbox at the neighbouring red house before the locked barrier.
knowledge.author: Tiina Tuominen
knowledge.details: The key to the locked barrier is in a lockbox at the neighbouring farm (the red house right before the barrier). Lockbox code is 2580.
